name: @guardbee/mcp-owasp-scan
description: Unified OWASP MCP Top 10 scanner — one CLI/MCP that orchestrates GuardBee auditors against a path or a live tools/list, maps findings to MCP01–MCP10, and grades A–F
long_description: Competitor one-shot scanners (e.g. owasp-mcp-scan) connect live and emit a Top 10 gut-check. This package is GuardBee's answer: a meta-orchestrator over the modular suite. Path scans compose secret-scanner, mcp-server-auditor, oauth-auditor, audit-gap-auditor, context-oversharing-auditor, toxic-flow-auditor, and tool-poisoning-scanner; optional Shadow MCP discover covers MCP09. Live and catalog modes call tools/list (or accept a dump) for toxic-flow + description poisoning with A–F grading and SARIF. No API key required — runs locally.
